review_candidates.description: Public Infrastructure, is Denmark’s primary instrument for supporting large‑scale public infrastructure in developing countries. Fully integrated into Impact Fund Denmark, it remains a central component of Denmark’s development cooperation under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Danida). High‑quality infrastructure is essential for sustainable and inclusive economic and social development. Yet in many low‑ and middle‑income countries, project preparation and access to capital are limited. Public Infrastructure addresses this gap by providing concessional financing and technical expertise for non‑commercial public infrastructure projects in emerging markets and fragile states. Through this work, it contributes to the UN 2030 Agenda, the Sustainable Development Goals, and Denmark’s development strategy. Public Infrastructure supports projects across the full lifecycle - from early project definition and feasibility, through construction, to handover and monitoring of development results for up to five years after completion. The Role We are seeking an Investment Director with deep insight and a well-developed understanding of the possibilities, trends and instruments with concessional or blended finance, e.g. from multilateral development banks, EU or other institutions with a development mandate in concessional or blended finance. The role requires mastery of the full investment processes for public infrastructure projects, including financial analysis and structuring, assessment of development and climate impact, ESG evaluation, legal review, project scoping, due diligence, and negotiation of agreements. The Investment Director will carry out deal sourcing, networking, management of all key aspects of the investment process, including financial analysis and structuring, development, and climate impact, environmental, social and governance, legal, scoping and carrying through due diligence, negotiating agreements. Furthermore, the Investment Director will undertake management of portfolio through project development, feasibility, design and tendering. The Team The Public Infrastructure team consists of 10 colleagues that are based in Copenhagen, Johannesburg and Nairobi. The open position is a replacement for a colleague that is retiring at the end of the year, and will be based at our Headquarter in Copenhagen. Qualifications & demonstrated capabilities Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience Possess a university degree in a relevant field, for example in Economics or Finance Strong understanding of concessional and blended finance instruments from MDBs, the EU, and similar institutions Proven ability to manage all aspects of the public infrastructure investment process, including financial analysis, structuring, climate and development impact, ESG, legal review, due diligence, and negotiations Deal sourcing and networking with various stakeholders. Management of all key aspects of the investment process, including financial analysis and structuring, development, and climate impact, environmental, social and governance, legal, scoping and carrying through due diligence, negotiating agreements. Management of portfolio through project development, feasibility, design and tendering. Capacity to work independently, lead processes and project teams on your own and be a resource for others/ mentor others through challenging decision-making processes. Operational experience with managing infrastructure projects, e.g. water and sanitation, waste, energy or other. Successful project management with demonstrated ability to drive things forward in an often complex and political environment. The right candidate demonstrates patience, drive, pro-activity, and great structure. Effective and timely dialogue with relevant stakeholders. Professional sourcing and management of external consultants. Demonstrates precise and high-quality business writing. Your application Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 29 November. We conduct interviews on a rolling basis. About Impact Fund Denmark Impact Fund Denmark is a Danish impact investor under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Denmark. It is Denmark's development finance institution, investing to promote green, just and inclusive societies and support the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. For almost 60 years, Impact Fund Denmark has invested in more than 1,300 companies across 100 developing countries and emerging markets. By 2030, assets under management are expected to reach EUR 6.3 billion, up from EUR 3.3 billion in 2025. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark.
